question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Utilitarian
solution:
The correct answer is **option (4)** i.e. **'Unnecessary'.**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Utilitarian: **(प्रयोजनशील) Designed for practical use and efficiency rather than for aesthetics or luxury.

 
 
• **Example: **The kitchen was designed with ***utilitarian ***features to make cooking easier.
 
 
 
• **Unnecessary: **(अनावश्यक) Not required or essential; surplus; more than what is needed.
 
 
• **Example:** Bringing an extra suitcase on the weekend trip seemed ***unnecessary***.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate ANTONYM of '**Utilitarian**' is Unnecessary.

*Therefore, the correct answer is* ***'Unnecessary'.*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Evident:** (स्पष्ट) Clearly seen, understood, or noticeable.

 
 
• **Example: **The impact of climate change is becoming more ***evident ***with rising temperatures. 
 
 
 
• **Necessary:** (आवश्यक) Required, essential, or needed in a particular situation.
 
 
• **Example: **Good communication is ***necessary ***for successful teamwork.
 
 
 
• **Spacious:** (जिसमें बहुत जगह हो) Having ample space or room; roomy and comfortable in terms of size.
 
 
• **Example: **Their new spacious living room has a utilitarian design.
